verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say Agent provisions the database automatically, with separate Development and Production environments. The add-database walkthrough shows the database wired into the app so its data persists across refresh, restart, and publish, all within the builder. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the connection and schema are wired in (connection strings, migrations, data browser), and independent hands-on corroboration of the provisioning flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder
